backgrounds.colorSpace: sRGB (resolved UIColor, converted CGColor, then UIColor.getRed)

captureSamplingPolicy: 60Hz display-link callbacks during actual delivered touch; REST at least0.25s apart; maximum720 observations per launch; dropped frames and sequential getter brackets remain explicit
coordinates: window points; normalized coordinates divide by window bounds
effectiveOpacityScope: product of presentation opacity along UIView ancestors; excludes extra CALayer ancestors and material shader coverage
frameClock: captureStartT...captureEndT bracket sequential presentation reads; t is row enqueue time
layerGeometryCoordinates: positionX/Y are superlayer points; anchorPointX/Y are unit bounds coordinates; boundsX/Y are local bounds origin points; presentation layer when available
rangeGeometryProbeScope: only the opt-in range scene retains all UIView model geometry and cached public UISlider layout results; sequential reads use captureStartT...captureEndT
sliderFixedShapeCoverageScope: stationary unique colored shape source; public drag moves native Slider; actual endpoint path and presentation geometry establish held coverage; no native override
sliderLayerProbeScope: opt-in public model geometry and CAAnimation reads; no control mutation; sequential reads use the enclosing capture bracket
sliderMarkerTransportScope: explicit fixed native Slider held with public input; source translations are original external PNG bytes; legacy static external inputs remain REST-only
